player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in German Whist.
{phase_info}
You hold {hand_size} cards.
Play a card with '[play N]', where N is its position in your hand (for example '[play 3]').
player_prompt.phase_learning: NUGBLƆÐEŊU: Ame si ɖu dzi le ayemenu ɖesiaɖe me la xɔa agbalẽ gbadzaa eye amesi bu lae toa eƒe lɛta bubu. Ayemenu siwo woxɔna le ɣeyiɣi sia me mele xexlẽme o hena dziɖuɖu.
player_prompt.phase_playing: ÐEÐEWO: Wowu agba la katã nu. Tso fifia dzi yina la, aɖaŋu ɖesiaɖe si nàɖe akpɔ dzidzedzee nye esi hiã be nàɖu aʋa sia dzi.

next_card.playing_phase: Womele ka aɖeke nam o - fefe dze egɔme.
next_card.deck_empty: Asikpuiawo le ƒuƒlu - wometsɔ agbalẽ aɖeke na o.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mɔnu si ŋu womeɖe mɔ ɖo o. Zã '[play N]' nàtsɔ aƒo Nth-kpata le asi me.
invalid_move.bad_position: Menye teƒee agbalẽa le o. Àte ŋu alé {hand_size}gbalẽvi ɖe asi.
invalid_move.invalid_play: Womate ŋu awɔ dɔ le agbalẽ ma dzi o.

trick.won: Fefewɔla {winner_id} si tsɔ ƒleƒuka la ɖu dzi kple {card}.
trick.won_learning: Player {winner_id} wins the trick with {card} and takes the face-up card.

phase.learning_complete: Nufiafiamɔ la wu enu - aɖaŋu ɖesiaɖe si susɔ le vevie hena aʋadziɖuɖu.

draw.loser_received: Èbu nugbea eye nèɖe {card} le agba la me.

turn.scores_learning: Dzidzedze si wɔ dɔ - Dɔdzikpɔla 0: {tricks0}, Dɔdzikpɔla 1: {tricks1}
